Welcome to Dr. Betty’s Vet Life! 🐔🐶
Join me as I share poultry farm tips, pet care advice, behind-the-scenes vlogs, and my journey as a veterinarian. I also guide new vet graduates with tips, stories, and inspiration from real-life veterinary practice.
🔔 Subscribe for weekly vet tips, farm adventures, and vet life insights!
